random_concept.name: Mirror Gong Laboratory
random_concept.description: A controlled editorial performance photograph freezes one adult performer's open-palm strike against a tensioned circular mirror-finish metallized-PET membrane; the contact dimple and concentric ripples break a ladder of strip-light reflections into nested elliptical highlight bands.
random_concept.selection_method: Independent spontaneous concept selection from model general knowledge within the assigned broad seed; no project-local concept material and no public-web inspiration were consulted.

general_knowledge_basis: A tensioned flexible membrane can show a contact dimple and outward-traveling radial deformation at the instant of impact.
Mirror-finish metallized PET produces directional specular reflections that visibly bend and fragment as its surface curvature changes.
Long strip sources reflected across nested curved regions can form a difficult but photographically judgeable hierarchy of central streaks, elliptical bands, and rim highlights.
A matte-black controlled stage and sparse reflective supports can isolate the gesture while preserving plausible editorial-performance construction.

preserved_scope: hair length color texture and part continuity

not_inspected_or_generated: skill assets references scripts or tests
